desc: 玫红泵瓶配腮红分栏与水彩机制晕染，空对比格承载自适色叙事
leaf: 自适色遮瑕防晒粉底液泵瓶
name: 玫红泵瓶自适色粉底款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代玫红柱形瓶与异形泵头。
用两排真实膏体色滴从浅到深的匀谱，回答一泵适配多少肤色。
用同机位同光同脸的双联裸妆对照，一秒展示匀净水光的即时变化。
用左粉栏三枚留白图标右持瓶肖像的分栏版式，把三大利益排成一眼清单。
用一尾水彩质地的微色素晕染讲清揉开即变暖融合的变色机制。
用一道乳白抹痕配三行空名成分栏承接配方叙事，名称与功效留白自填。
用四组双联前后实拍拼成的留白口碑墙收口信任，人数与署名全部空置。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm off-white #F5F3F0 field for packshot, board and science frames, rose-blush split panel #D98A9A carrying white serif type beside a portrait half, pale petal wash #F6E9EC reserved for grid screens, no dark stages
style.direction: editorial rose-flush adaptive foundation commerce, serif headlines and watercolour science

style.lightingSystem: soft editorial beauty light near 5700K, broad diffused key with gentle modelling on the pump shoulder, real skin texture kept visible in comparison crops, shadowless boards, never heavy glow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial rose-flush adaptive foundation ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of rose bottle #B34A5C, blush panel #D98A9A, warm off-white field #F5F3F0 and ink serif #1B1B1E; soft editorial beauty light near 5700K with a broad diffused key, real skin texture kept visible in comparison crops and shadowless boards; matte rose cylinder, cream swipe ridges, watercolour blooms and plain studio paper only, no dark stages, no marble, no gold trim; one high-contrast serif with a calm sans kept as empty placeholder slots; thin white pictograms without captions and hairline ingredient rails left blank; blank rose bottle body with sculpted nozzle; no color palette changes, no readable lettering, no customer counts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no customer counts or SPF figures
style.presentationRules: the bottle always shows a blank rose body with no wordmark and the sculpted nozzle exposed or capped beside it, people in comparison and UGC crops are generic with softened identity, swatch drops keep real pigment body, watercolour swirl stays illustrative
style.surfaceSystem: matte rose cylinder with gloss pump head, thick cream swipe ridges, watercolour pigment bloom on paper, plain studio paper, no marble, no gold trim
